chunks: It will come upon them unawares confounding them, and they will not be able to keep it back, nor will they be given respite.
ai.seo_question: How will divine punishment arrive upon people according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the abruptness of divine retribution, contrasting with the gradual warnings given to prophets, thereby underscoring the suddenness of the Hour for those who neglect it. The term 'baghtatan' (suddenly) signifies a complete surprise that leaves no time for repentance or strategic defense, a concept often linked to the concept of *Barzakh* and the finality of the Day of Judgment. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on constant vigilance (*Yaqzah*) in preparation for an unexpected divine encounter.
